title: Jesus... Why Does Everything Come Easy For Her?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus, why does everything come easy for her?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: My sister. She does not even try and it lands.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Fine. I am jealous and I hate that I am jealous.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Thank you. That is the first honest thing you have said today.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Aren't You going to tell me it is wrong?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Bitterness will eat you. I would rather you hand it to Me than carry it politely.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I do not know how to be happy for her.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Start smaller. Be kind to her before you are happy for her. The feeling follows the choice.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then you will have been kind anyway, and that is not nothing. I am not comparing you to her. I never was.

bible.text: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, brawling and slander, along with every form of malice. Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.
